packageRules.description: testdata/fixtures/** are integration-test INPUTS, not dependencies. They are copied into temp dirs to exercise grove's project-type detection, so their versions are what the tests assert against, not what grove ships. config:recommended skips test/ and tests/ but not testdata/, which is why Renovate proposed bumping the fixture ruby tag. Worse, the same 'FROM ruby:3.3-slim' string is hardcoded in internal/testhelper/helpers.go, which Renovate cannot see: bumping only the fixture would silently diverge the two. Update fixtures by hand, alongside the helper.
